clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/create -d '{"collectionName": "test_rename_src", "dimension": 4, "metricType": "L2"}' && curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/rename -d '{"collectionName": "test_rename_src", "newCollectionName": "test_rename_dst", "dbName": "default"}' && curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/create -d '{"collectionName": "test_rename_dst", "dimension": 4, "metricType": "L2"}'

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_collections_rename_001 - endpoint: collections+rename, expected: 400 when new name already exists
contract_grounding.note: Contract expects rename to fail with error when target name conflicts with existing collection. Actual behavior: rename succeeds (code=0) while concurrent create with same name also succeeds.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: RenameCollection → StartBroadcastWithResourceKeys (DB locks) → CheckIfCollectionRenamable (RLock check) → concurrent CreateCollection (separate DB lock, no check for pending renames)
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现：Rename 使用 ExclusiveDBNameResourceKey 锁定数据库，但 CheckIfCollectionRenamable 仅用 RLock 读锁检查已存在的集合名。并发场景下，Rename 检查通过后（test_rename_dst 不存在），与 CreateCollection（使用不同的 ExclusiveCollectionNameResourceKey）竞态，导致两者都成功执行，造成同名集合状态歧义。这是一个典型的 TOCTOU (time-of-check-to-time-of-use) 并发竞态缺陷。

falsification.observed: test_rename_dst exists (collectionID=468359796041079935) with data; test_rename_src not found (code=100). State confusion confirmed - rename succeeded AND create succeeded, leaving ambiguous which collection the name 'test_rename_dst' refers to.

verdicts.rationale: 通过干净环境独立复现（Step 1 成功）、契约对照（Step 3 确认违反预期）、源码接地（Step 3.5 发现 TOCTOU 竞态）、反向证伪（Step 4 确认状态混乱实际存在）以及平凡解释排除（Step 5 排除环境/参数问题），确认这是一个真实的并发状态逻辑缺陷。关键证据：Rename 和 Create 并发执行时，CheckIfCollectionRenamable 的 RLock 检查与 CreateCollection 的数据库锁之间存在时间窗口，导致两者都能通过验证并成功执行，造成集合名状态歧义。这属于 Type4_StateLogicViolation，违背了集合名的唯一性不变式。
